bar.page_text:
Lumen Ledger
How it works
Plans
Help
Know where your money goes

Lumen Ledger sorts every household bill into clear groups and shows each month as a picture you can read in seconds.

Start a free ledger

Spending is down 12% this month.

One ledger, every bill
Sorted for you

Each bill lands in the right group as soon as you add it, with no rules to set up.

Reminders

A short note arrives before each bill is due, so nothing slips past.

Shared with family

Invite the people you live with, and everyone sees the same tidy picture of the month.

This month at a glance

82%

of the budget used

3 of 4

bills paid

▼ 12%

less spent on food

“I finally know where the grocery money goes, and the reminders keep us on time.”

Ana, a parent of two
